notes.title: Deadly Land starts a small beta test
notes.content:
If you like NAR's Zombie-Mode, you may also be interested in the game "Deadly Land"

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1234260/Deadly_Land/

[previewyoutube=aFmKReEz9pM;full][/previewyoutube]

Deadly Land is a first-person zombie shooter. This game will be released soon and needs a few more testers.

Check out this event :)
[h1][b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791466229770/announcements/detail/3177789694291189100]Take Part in the BETA[/url][/b][/h1]

notes.title: Weapon Settings
notes.content:
[b]NAR[/b] needs your support. 
Do you already have experience in shooter games?
You know how the weapons feel? You know the respective recoil, the spread and so on? 
Then [b]you[/b] are the right one for this job!

Have a look at the video and send me an e-mail with your Steam name to sign up for it.
Write your e-mail to: info@playnar.com

[previewyoutube=7HayKYuHIoQ;full][/previewyoutube]
